name: app.foxaway/foxaway
title: FoxAway
description: Cheap flights from Russia and the CIS: fares, price calendars, deals, visas and trip briefs.

tools.name: find_cheap_flights
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what a flight costs on a route (a day, a month or the next 90 days, within a budget) or wants the cheapest flight from their city: «сколько стоит билет Москва — Стамбул», «how much is a flight from Tashkent to Dubai». Without destination: the cheapest places to fly. 300+ departure cities, most in Russia, Central Asia and the Caucasus. Exact dates give exact matches; other dates come in nearby_dates. If nothing fits, it returns the closest options and says what was relaxed. two_one_way = two one-way tickets. Flights only: no trains, flight status or booking.

origin.description: Departure city: name in Russian or English or IATA code (e.g. 'Москва', 'Ташкент', 'Алматы', 'MOW', 'LIS').

destination.description: Destination city or country: name in Russian or English, IATA city code or ISO-2 country code (e.g. 'Стамбул', 'Turkey', 'IST', 'TR').

depart.description: Departure date YYYY-MM-DD or month YYYY-MM. Optional.

return_date.description: Return date YYYY-MM-DD for a round trip (only with an exact depart date). Optional.

currency.description: ISO code of max_price currency: USD, EUR, RUB, GBP, AED, TRY, KZT, UZS, KGS, TJS, TMT, AZN, AMD, GEL, BYN, MDL, UAH, CNY, THB; other codes (INR, JPY, SAR…) when a live rate exists. Prices are shown in this currency with USD alongside; default RUB for Russian cities, else USD.

citizenship.description: Passport country (name or ISO-2), if the user said it: each option then carries a visa mark (needed or not).

adults.description: Adults (12+), default 1. Prices stay per 1 adult; the link opens the search for everyone.

children_ages.description: Ages of children on the travel date, e.g. [7, 1]; under 2 = infant without a seat.

infants.description: Infants under 2 without a seat (if ages are not given).

checked_baggage.description: The user needs checked baggage. Baggage is not checked in prices; the answer says so.

direct_only.description: Only direct flights; options with unknown stops are left out.

max_duration_hours.description: Longest acceptable outbound travel time, hours; options with unknown duration are left out.

min_nights.description: Round trip of at least N nights (when there is no exact return date).

max_nights.description: Round trip of at most N nights.

include_nearby.description: Also check nearby departure cities (e.g. Samarkand for Tashkent) on the same dates; results in from_nearby.

lang.description: Answer language; default: the user's locale, else Russian.

tools.name: explore_destinations
tools.description: Use this when the user has no destination yet: where to fly cheaply from a city (300+ departure cities), cheapest first, by period, budget, region, country, theme (sea, warm, visa_free, weekend) or N nights — also loose wishes: «удиви меня», «куда сбежать от зимы», «на море недорого», «I have $300 and a week». One call covers the question; if nothing fits, it returns the closest options and says what was relaxed. Do not use when a route and dates are named (find_cheap_flights). Flights only.

origin.description: Departure city: name in Russian or English or IATA code (e.g. 'Москва', 'Ташкент', 'Алматы', 'MOW', 'LIS').

when.description: Period: 7d, weekend, month (next 30 days, default), half (6 months), all, or a month YYYY-MM.

mood.description: Kind of place when the user describes a mood rather than a destination: mountains, nature, romance, food…

theme.description: sea — by the sea, only where the month has beach weather (air and sea temperature, item.climate), warm — warm places, visa_free — no visa for `citizenship`, weekend — this weekend.

currency.description: ISO code of max_price currency: USD, EUR, RUB, GBP, AED, TRY, KZT, UZS, KGS, TJS, TMT, AZN, AMD, GEL, BYN, MDL, UAH, CNY, THB; other codes (INR, JPY, SAR…) when a live rate exists. Prices are shown in this currency with USD alongside.

region.description: europe, asia, schengen, middle_east, africa, latam, cis, oceania, … Optional.

country.description: Only this destination country (name or ISO-2). Optional.

visa_free.description: Only destinations without a visa for `citizenship`. Pass citizenship when known; without it the visa filter is not applied and the answer says so.

citizenship.description: Passport country (name or ISO-2): RU, UZ, KZ, BY. Pass it if the user said it; without it the answer lists the four passports when their rules differ.

round_trip.description: Round trip instead of one way.

nights.description: Trip length in nights (implies round trip).

adults.description: Adults (12+), default 1. Prices stay per 1 adult; the link opens the search for everyone.

children_ages.description: Ages of children on the travel date, e.g. [7, 1]; under 2 = infant without a seat.

infants.description: Infants under 2 without a seat (if ages are not given).

checked_baggage.description: The user needs checked baggage. Baggage is not checked in prices; the answer says so.

direct_only.description: Only direct flights; options with unknown stops are left out.

max_duration_hours.description: Longest acceptable outbound travel time, hours; options with unknown duration are left out.

min_nights.description: Round trip of at least N nights (when there is no exact return date).

max_nights.description: Round trip of at most N nights.

lang.description: Answer language; default: the user's locale, else Russian.

tools.name: price_calendar
tools.description: Use this when dates are flexible and the user wants the cheapest days of a month on a route, or to compare up to 10 destinations in one call (destinations): «в какие дни декабря дешевле в Стамбул», «сравни Стамбул, Дубай и Анталью», «cheapest days to fly to Bangkok in January», «Türkiye mi Gürcistan mı daha ucuz». Do not use for one fixed date: use find_cheap_flights. next_step: tracking link for the month; offer it once.

origin.description: Departure city: name in Russian or English or IATA code (e.g. 'Москва', 'Ташкент', 'Алматы', 'MOW', 'LIS').

destination.description: Destination city or country: name in Russian or English, IATA city code or ISO-2 country code (e.g. 'Стамбул', 'Turkey', 'IST', 'TR').

destinations.description: Several destinations at once (cities or countries), instead of destination.

month.description: Month YYYY-MM (default: current, or the next one with prices).

trip.description: ow — one way (default), rt — round trip (days of departure).

lang.description: Answer language; default: the user's locale, else Russian.

tools.name: deals_now
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for current flight deals or last-minute cheap tickets from a city: fresh finds noticeably cheaper than the route's usual price («горящие билеты из Ташкента», «какие сейчас скидки на билеты», «flight deals from Almaty this week»). Do not use for a specific route or dates: use find_cheap_flights or price_calendar. next_step: such deals from the user's city every day in Telegram; offer it once.

origin.description: Departure city (optional): name or IATA code.

lang.description: Answer language; default: the user's locale, else Russian.

tools.name: trip_brief
tools.description: Use this when the user prepares a trip: visa for RU, UZ, KZ or BY passports (needed or not, how to apply, processing time, official link), best season, usual weather of the month, warnings, money, eSIM, customs, daily costs, checklist, trip ideas, airline baggage: «нужна ли виза», «что взять с собой», «когда лучше ехать», «Gürcistan'a vize gerekiyor mu». Pass citizenship if known; without it, if passports differ, the answer lists them. Do not use for a forecast for the coming days or flight status.

destination.description: Destination city or country: name in Russian or English, IATA city code or ISO-2 country code (e.g. 'Стамбул', 'Turkey', 'IST', 'TR').

citizenship.description: Passport country (name or ISO-2): RU, UZ, KZ, BY. Pass it if the user said it; without it the answer lists the four passports when their rules differ.

month.description: Travel month YYYY-MM (optional: season and usual weather of the month).

airline.description: Airline name or IATA code (optional): its baggage allowance by fare.

lang.description: Answer language; default: the user's locale, else Russian.

tools.name: travel_services
tools.description: Use this when the user asks where to book something for a trip to a destination: hotels, eSIM, travel insurance, airport transfer, excursions, package tours («где снять отель в Стамбуле», «какую eSIM взять в Турцию», «travel insurance for Georgia»). Do not use for general shopping such as luggage or clothes. Links lead to FoxAway country guides and to third-party services; give them as they are. FoxAway does not book or take payments.

destination.description: Destination city or country: name in Russian or English, IATA city code or ISO-2 country code (e.g. 'Стамбул', 'Turkey', 'IST', 'TR').

lang.description: Answer language; default: the user's locale, else Russian.

tools.name: follow_price
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to watch a fare or be told when it drops («следи за ценой», «напомни, когда подешевеет», «alert me when the price drops»), or says they are not ready to buy or the price is too high: a one-tap link to the FoxAway Telegram bot that turns on free price tracking for a route (exact dates or a month) after the user presses Start; the FoxAway bot messages the user when the fare drops. Flights only.
